decisions.reason: Organizing funnel reporting by Contact Source does not change whether email or LinkedIn communication history is visible in HubSpot.
The report uses existing lead stages for grouped counts but does not change the lead-management stages, categorization, lists, notes, or task behavior.
The reporting change does not alter synchronization of MeetAlfred reply status into HubSpot.
The source specifies report contents without changing the selected HubSpot platform, subscription plan, or general CRM use.
Contact Source is described as a campaign label for reporting; the source does not change list transfer or synchronization from HubSpot to MeetAlfred.
The funnel-reporting specification does not change the source selection, export method, or Apollo destination.
The source concerns grouping CRM report data and does not change how the Sales Navigator lead list is configured.
Viewing contacts and conversion in a report does not change Apollo-to-HubSpot transfer behavior or latency.
The Contact Source reporting structure does not affect which type of LinkedIn profile URL is stored.
The reporting request neither resolves nor changes the deferred and ambiguous direct LinkedIn-to-HubSpot integration requirement.
The report organization and conversion metrics do not change the minimal-integration policy or lead-transfer interaction.
The reporting request does not change the enrichment provider, fields, or automatic enrichment mode.
